title: Reputation
headline: A critic gave Taylor Swift's Reputation a D+. Years later, his own site said it got it wrong.
caption:
Reputation came out on November 10, 2017. Swift skipped the usual press run and let the music speak, while reviews ranged from rave to D+.

Instead of interviews, she held secret listening sessions for 500 fans she picked herself from social media, at her homes in Rhode Island, Los Angeles, London and Nashville.

Years later, critics came around. NPR's Ann Powers called it an album "once-scorned, now revered."

So who got it right: the D+ or the No. 1?

🎧 Key track: "Look What You Made Me Do" by Taylor Swift (@taylorswift)
